---

```{r}
x = co2
head(x)
```

```{r}
plot(x)
```
```{r}
 train = window(x,end=c(1989,12))
test = window(x,start = c(1990,1))
```
```{r}
plot(train,xlim=c(1960,2000),ylim=c(min(x),max(x)))
lines(test,lty=2,col=2)
```
```{r}
# simple exponential smoothing
ses = HoltWinters(train,beta = FALSE,gamma = FALSE)
p_ses = predict(ses,n.ahead = length(test))
ses_MAPE = 100*mean(abs(p_ses-test)/test)
plot(train,xlim=c(1960,2000),ylim=c(min(x),max(x)))
lines(p_ses,col=2)
lines(test,lty=2,col=4)
```

```{r}
ahw = HoltWinters(train,alpha=NULL,beta = NULL,gamma=NULL,seasonal = "additive")
p_ahw = predict(ahw,n.ahead = length(test))
ahw_MAPE = 100*mean(abs(p_ahw-test)/test)
plot(train,xlim=c(1960,2000),ylim=c(min(x),max(x)))
lines(p_ahw,col=2)
lines(test,lty=2,col=4)
```
